name: A pension from a country without a treaty in the parameters (taxedIn source, its tax credited)
workings: XA (a made-up country code) has no treaty in the parameters, so nothing exempts its pension: Germany taxes a resident's world income and credits the tax charged abroad (§34c Abs. 1), although the plan says the paying country taxes it, with a warning
A statutory pension started in 2030: 86% taxable; from 2031 the exempt 14% × 10,000 = 1,400 is fixed. Taxable pensions: 86% × 30,409.60 − 102 = 26,050.2560
Health: DRV 1,785.84 + 8.75% × 10,000 = 875.00 (a foreign statutory pension, half the rate); care 4.2% × 30,409.60 = 1,277.2032
